statusLine.command: p=$(cat); d=$(printf '%s' "$p" | jq -r '.workspace.project_dir // empty' 2>/dev/null); s="$d/.claude/statusline.sh"; [ -x "$s" ] || s="$(git -C "${d:-.}" rev-parse --show-toplevel 2>/dev/null)/.claude/statusline.sh"; [ -x "$s" ] && printf '%s' "$p" | "$s"; true

subagentStatusLine.command: jq -c '.tasks[]? | {id, content: ([([.name, .description, .type] | map(select(. != null and . != "")) | first // "agent"), ((.model // empty) | sub("^claude-"; "")), ((.effort // empty) | tostring), (if (.contextWindowSize // 0) > 0 then ((((.tokenCount // 0) * 100 / .contextWindowSize) | floor | tostring) + "% ctx") else empty end)] | join(" · "))}' 2>/dev/null || true
